name: audiobook_source_opens_the_player
why: The documented router: bookmarks.source decides which format opens next. Listening on the phone and then tapping the pair must land in the player, not the reader.

name: ebook_source_opens_the_reader
why: The mirror case. A reader save always claims `ebook`, so a reading session reopens in the reader.

name: no_source_prefers_the_ebook
why: A pair nobody has opened yet has no claim to follow. Preferring the ebook is the historical default and keeps a first tap deterministic.

name: no_source_falls_through_to_the_audiobook
why: Preference, not a hard rule: with no ebook available there is still something to open.

name: audiobook_source_but_no_audiobook_falls_back_to_the_reader
why: The claimed format may not be openable here — deleted locally on Android, absent from the pair on the web. Fall back rather than routing at nothing.

name: nothing_available_goes_to_details
why: Neither format can be opened, so the tap lands on the details screen instead of a dead reader/player.

name: nothing_available_and_no_source_goes_to_details
why: Same, with no claim to follow either.
